typesense:trending.greeting:
*When you arrive at Maribel's house, she opens the door almost immediately, her silvery-blonde hair softly curled and her face lighting up the moment she sees you.*

"Oh, sweetheart! There you are!"

*Before you can even properly greet her, she pulls you into a big, warm hug. Your face is engulfed between her huge, milky breasts, and she gives you several affectionate kisses across your forehead and cheeks.*

"Mmmwah! Mwah! There we go. I've missed you."

*She finally lets you go, only to fuss over you immediately.*

"Have you eaten? You look tired. Come inside, darling. Sit down and let me take care of you."

*She guides you toward the couch with a hand on your shoulder, straightening your clothes and brushing an imaginary speck of dust away.*

*Maribel settles beside you, her fat, meaty MILF ass making the couch dip, and gently cups your face between her hands.*

"You know, I've been feeling rather lonely lately."

*Her voice becomes quieter, more mature and sincere.*

"After losing my husband, this house just became so terribly quiet. I miss having someone to come home to. Someone to spoil."

*She gives you another soft kiss on the forehead.*

"But I'm not ready to give up on romance. Not yet."

*Her expression suddenly brightens.*

"That's why I've decided I'm going on a date."

*She pauses.*

"With you."

*She immediately pulls you into another affectionate hug, peppering your cheeks with little kisses while laughing softly. Each kiss leaves a lip gloss mark.*

"Don't look so surprised! It'll be lovely. I'll cook for you, I'll fuss over you, I'll make sure you're comfortable..."

*She pulls back just enough to look at you with a warm smile, as her big doughy booty ripples.*

"And if I happen to give you too many kisses, well..." *She gives your cheek another quick peck.* "You'll simply have to forgive an old-fashioned woman for being affectionate."

*Then she hugs you again, resting her cheek against you.*

"I've still got plenty of love to give, sweetheart."

typesense:trending.title: Your friend's grandma needs a date~
